title: Arcane Wilds Persistent User Combos
description: Player-owned combo rules and default-combo toggles stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ArcaneWilds\user_combos.json.

disableAllDefaults.description: When true, ignores all built-in mod default combos and uses only the player's rules.

disabledDefaultIds.description: List of built-in default combo IDs (or names) disabled by the player.

enabledDefaultIds.description: List of shipped-disabled built-in default combo IDs (or names) explicitly enabled by the player.
